Neither item names an inspectable artifact, metric, or command output at its own task boundary (verification is entirely deferred to T-005, a separate task) — the failure mode is that a quality-gate reviewer closing T-003 or T-004 has no observable check to run against this specific criterion, only the implementer's own unverified claim of correctness, which is the same defect class OBSERVABLE-DONE's forbidden-phrase list ('works correctly') targets. Remedy: replace each item with either (a) removal (since it adds no independently-checkable criterion beyond the task's own TDD-evidence item), or (b) a concrete, task-local check (e.g. a unit-level assertion inspecting capability_evaluations[]/conditional_facet_evaluations[] structure directly, independent of T-005's suite).
